content_zh:
于蓉嗤笑一声，轻蔑的说道：“我当你是觉得命运不公，才会如此抗拒，毕竟，你曾经的未婚夫，在将来的不久会迎娶我的女儿，你们两个的身份，一个天上一个地下！”
“其实，若不是你有一个外祖家，你以为皇帝会将你赐婚二皇子？还是说，你认为自己能和我的若儿比？说实话，我的若儿知书达理，天赋异禀，只有她，才配当皇子妃。”
“不仅如此，日后，若儿还要母仪天下，你只配在尘埃里仰望她。”
她的若儿如此优秀，岂是白颜能与之相比？
当真是笑话！
“我倒是觉得，你唯一的用处，就是用来换一枚三品丹药，为了念及你的付出，等三品丹药入手，我会给你看上一眼，否则，以你这废物，一辈子都见不到三品丹药！”
白颜嗤笑一声，前世，她连八品丹药都能给炼制，何况三品？
“若你们今天找我来，只是为了说这些，那我还是劝你们省点力气！”白颜的眸子淡淡的扫过房内的两人，“不过……今天之事，我白颜来日？
于老夫人满脸不屑，等她入了钱家，还有来日？
白颜丢下这一句后之后，便潇洒的转身离开，她没有回头，一身红衣消失在了午后宁静的阳光下。
在离开了于蓉的房间之后，白颜就径自的走入了自己的房内，安然淡定的盘膝坐在床头。
若是有人在这的话，便会发现一股淡淡的真气流淌到她的体内。
这股真气为淡淡的黄，是黄阶才有的特征。
“三个月的时间，才到黄阶高级，这种晋级速度太慢了，若是现在能炼制丹药的话，我就能够改善体质，速度也会上升几倍。”
当然，曾经的白颜仅是人阶高级，连丫鬟都不如，至少，丫鬟都有黄阶低级的实力。
之所以能到达黄阶高级，也是她这几个月来修炼的成果……
天空，很快暗了下来。
夜色沉静。
门外传来一阵窸窸窣窣的声音，白颜知道，是钱家来人了。
果不其然，两名丫鬟从门外走了进来，冷着一张脸：“和我们走。”

白颜没有说话，缓缓站起了身，向着房外走去。
侧门外，早就停着一顶轿子，因世人皆知白颜的实力，钱家派来的人倒是没有什么高手，仅是一些黄阶低级的丫鬟小厮。
那些人让白颜进入轿子之后，就关上了轿帘，飞快的往钱家赶去。
他们走的路很偏僻，兴许生怕会被人发现。
就在这时，砰的一声，烟尘四起，轿子突然间掉了下来，重重的砸在了地上。
“怎么回事？”
轿夫皆是一愣，赶忙进入轿子查探究竟，却发现，原先还坐在轿子内看守得丫鬟已经昏迷不醒。
轿塌上，少女的手慵懒的撑着下巴，三千青丝垂直而下，铺盖在席塌之上，美得夺人心魄。

content_en:
Yu Rong sneered and said contemptuously: "I thought you felt that your fate was unfair, that's why you resisted like this. After all, your former fiancé will marry my daughter in the near future. Your two identities are in heaven and earth!"
"Actually, if you didn't have a maternal ancestry, do you think the emperor would marry you to the second prince? Or do you think you can compare with my Ruo'er? To be honest, my Ruo'er is well-educated and talented. Only she is worthy of being the prince's concubine."
"Not only that, in the future, if your mother wants to honor the world, you only deserve to look up to her in the dust."
Her Ruo'er is so outstanding, how can Bai Yan compare with her?
What a joke!
"I think your only use is to exchange for a third-grade elixir. In order to remember your efforts, when the third-grade elixir is available, I will give you a look. Otherwise, you, a waste, will never see a third-grade elixir in your life!"
Bai Yan sneered. In her previous life, she could even refine eighth-grade elixirs, let alone third-grade elixirs.
"If you came to me today just to say this, then I would advise you to save some effort!" Bai Yan's eyes faintly swept over the two people in the room, "But... what will happen today, Bai Yan?"
Mrs. Yu's face was filled with disdain. What future would she have when she joined the Qian family?
After Bai Yan said these words, she turned around and left without looking back. She disappeared in the quiet afternoon sunshine in her red dress.
After leaving Yu Rong's room, Bai Yan walked directly into her own room and sat cross-legged on the bedside calmly.
If someone were here, they would find a faint flow of true energy flowing into her body.
This true energy has a light yellow color, which is a characteristic unique to Huang Jie.
"It took me three months to reach the advanced level of Huang level. This promotion speed is too slow. If I can refine the elixir now, I can improve my physique and the speed will increase several times. "
Of course, the former Bai Yan was only a high-level human-level person, not even as good as a maid. At least, the maid had the strength of a low-level Huang-level person.
The reason why she can reach the high level of Huang level is also the result of her cultivation in the past few months...
The sky quickly darkened.
The night is quiet.
There was a rustling sound outside the door, and Bai Yan knew that it was someone from the Qian family.
Sure enough, two maids walked in from outside the door, with cold faces: "Come with us. "
Bai Yan said nothing, stood up slowly, and walked out of the room.
Outside the side door, a sedan chair had been parked for a long time. Since everyone knew Bai Yan's strength, the people sent by the Qian family did not have any experts, just some low-level maids and servants of the yellow rank.
After those people let Bai Yan enter the sedan, they closed the sedan curtain and hurried to Qian's house.
The road they took was very remote, and they might be afraid of being discovered.
At this moment, there was a bang, smoke and dust flew everywhere, and the sedan suddenly fell down and hit the ground heavily.
"What's going on? "
The bearers were all stunned and hurriedly entered the sedan to investigate, only to find that the maid who was still sitting in the sedan watching over her was already unconscious.
On the sedan chair, the girl lazily supported her chin with her hands. Three thousand black hairs were hanging vertically down, covering the mat, which was so beautiful that it took your breath away.
